summary: Issue #642: the practice bot can answer any action the engine offers and no card play scores below passing. New in src/L5R.AI: AbilityIntent (card-agnostic reading of an ability), BotProfile (honor tier: Proclaim stance and gain-vs-loss), BotContext (cards seen, lobby turn, repeat-use decay, engine refusals), AttackPlanner (multi-province sub-armies), a generic completer and the policies Mendon specified (Proclaim/discount, draw gap, Lobby, Favor as a cost, destroy>bow>penalize>help, negating Reactions always, weighted others, honor choice). The client keeps one BotContext per practice match and MatchSession.StepPracticeOpponent now retries after a refused action. A soak harness (tests/L5R.AI.Tests/BotSoak.cs, docs/BOT_SOAK.md) plays random-deck bot-vs-bot matches over every wired card. The soak exposed five engine bugs, each fixed with a regression test that fails without the fix: Confusion at Court crashed on a card-less Favor action (ActionProtected), Encircled Terrain asked a player with no Personality to keep one (stalled the match), Kakita Yusugi could Proclaim again and again, the province-reveal choice was left with the wrong player's priority and offered to the wrong seat, and (bot) hand-size maximum was hard-coded. Shared: touches engine, AI and client under Mendon's standing authority (collaboration.json).
validation: Full Core suite 2374 PASS, 0 FAIL. AI suite 97/97, new bot-policy 9/9, CI soak 2/2. Soak 60 seeds (1-60): 59 finished, stall 0, illegal 0, cap 0, exception 0, 199 recovered refusals (engine action-list gaps, listed in the PR), 1 slow. A 400-match soak (seeds 1000-1399) was running at the time of writing. check_format and lint_comment_swallow clean. NOT verified: no human playtest of the new bot, no native client check; rules readings in the spec (family honor = Stronghold starting honor, 'equal number' for the lobby clause, deprioritized Proclaim = decline) are my interpretations.
remaining: Mendon to play against the bot and confirm the interpretations; engine action-list gaps from the soak; wire the bot's own decklist (DeckAveragePersonalHonor) from practice setup; read the 400-match soak.
